name: Hearthstone Cooldown Tweaks

sql.note: upstream's reset, then the chosen file (one of _1_Sec/_1_Min/_5_Min/_15_Min/_30_Min), as ONE transaction: every other file only moves a Hearthstone still on the stock cooldown (WHERE spellcooldown_1=-1), so the reset must come first -- and a chosen file that fails must take the reset with it
upstream's own undo, back to the 30-minute default

notes: Applies after a restart or .reload spells.
The five choices are the five files upstream ships (AsgavinYT/hearthstone-cooldowns);
30_Min is its reset. A `choice` opens the Install dialog even with a default (T100).
Update or a second Install asks again with the DEFAULT selected -- the earlier answer
is not remembered (T104) -- and applies whatever is picked then; the dialog says so.
Remove used to UPDATE spell_dbc row 8690 (ported from wow-manage.sh), a table install
never wrote; it now runs the reset file against item_template, where install wrote.
